name: ClickCease Click Fraud Protection
author: eranfl

sections.description:
Bots and invalid traffic can reach your site through paid, organic, and direct traffic, resulting in a wasted ad budget and disrupted marketing funnels.

Prevent bots, competitors, and malicious users from damaging your marketing performance with ClickCease, the industry-leading service that keeps your website and ads safe from fraud. Quick installation and real-time protection for all your website’s incoming traffic.

ClickCease protects you from invalid traffic by monitoring and protecting your:

  • Paid traffic (Google, Facebook, & Microsoft)
  • Organic traffic
  • Direct traffic

Put a stop to ad and click fraud on your website with our market-leading AI software. Allow yourself to fully focus on growing your business without having online fraud distract you.

You will need an active ClickCease subscription to use this WordPress plugin.

Lead Shield form validation. Validate leads from Gravity Forms, WPForms and Contact Form 7. Choose the forms to protect in your ClickCease dashboard; verdicts are added to Gravity Forms and WPForms entries and shown in the dashboard for all three.

External services

The plugin uses services provided by CHEQ, the company behind ClickCease (Terms of Service, Privacy Policy):

  • Bot detection: when Bot Zapping is active, each visitor page load sends the visitor’s IP address, page URL, browser headers and the CHEQ cookie, to decide whether to block the visit.
  • CHEQ tag and ClickCease tracking: scripts loaded in the visitor’s browser to detect invalid traffic and click fraud. ClickCease tracking can be turned off in the plugin settings.
  • Account and diagnostics: your ClickCease keys are verified, and the plugin’s status, version, site domain and logs (including visitor IP addresses) are sent to support your installation.
  • Lead Shield: on sites connected to a ClickCease 2.0 account with Lead Shield, Gravity Forms, WPForms and Contact Form 7 submissions (email address, phone number, form identifiers and the ClickCease visit identifier) and the list of form names are sent to CHEQ. Only the forms you choose in the dashboard are validated; other submissions are discarded.

The plugin settings page uses Mixpanel for usage analytics, linked to your ClickCease client ID (Terms of Use, Privacy Policy).
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from the WordPress Plugin Directory or upload it manually.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu in WordPress.
  3. Enter your ClickCease API keys in the plugin settings.
  4. Click “Save” to enable protection.
sections.faq:
Is there a free protection package?

ClickCease offers a 7 day free trial for you to run a traffic audit.

Will your plugin slow down my website?

No. ClickCease uses a synchronous code that does not slow down page or site load speeds.

What are the benefits of using ClickCease?

Secure your ad campaigns and website from malicious bots and competitors with ClickCease. Using advanced click fraud protection to protect your ad campaigns as well as accurate on-site bot detection and prevention, ClickCease makes sure all your marketing efforts are going towards real and potential customers only.

What else do I need for this plugin to work?

You will need to sign up for a ClickCease subscription at ClickCease.com. Our free 7 day trial allows you to get started blocking bad traffic.
